description: AI-assisted reference scenarios reviewed and refined during benchmark preparation, before evaluation of the R1 model outputs

scenarios.precondition: The username and email are not already registered.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Register a user with valid username, email, password, matching confirmation, and role.
scenarios.expected_result: A new user record is created and a success message containing the user ID is returned.

scenarios.precondition: A user with the submitted username already exists.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to register another user with the same username.
scenarios.expected_result: Registration is rejected with a validation error.

scenarios.precondition: A user with the submitted email already exists.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to register another user with the same email.
scenarios.expected_result: Registration is rejected with a validation error.

scenarios.precondition: The remaining registration fields are valid.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to register with a username shorter than 3 characters.
scenarios.expected_result: Registration is rejected with a validation error.

scenarios.precondition: The remaining registration fields are valid.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to register with a password shorter than 8 characters.
scenarios.expected_result: Registration is rejected with a validation error.

scenarios.precondition: The user is authenticated as ADMIN. The book data is valid.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Add a book with required title and author, positive total copies, and available copies within the allowed range.
scenarios.expected_result: The book is created in the catalog and a new book ID is returned.

scenarios.precondition: The user is ADMIN and another book already has the submitted ISBN.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to add a book with the duplicate ISBN.
scenarios.expected_result: Book creation is rejected with a validation error.

scenarios.precondition: The user is authenticated as ADMIN.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to add a book without the required title.
scenarios.expected_result: Book creation is rejected with a validation error.

scenarios.precondition: The user is ADMIN and all other book fields are valid.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to create a book with total copies equal to zero.
scenarios.expected_result: Book creation is rejected because total copies must be greater than zero.

scenarios.precondition: The user is ADMIN and all other book fields are valid.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to create a book with available copies greater than total copies.
scenarios.expected_result: Book creation is rejected because available copies cannot exceed total copies.

scenarios.precondition: An existing book is selected by an authenticated ADMIN.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Update the book with valid information.
scenarios.expected_result: The book record is updated, the change is logged, and confirmation is returned.

scenarios.precondition: An existing book is selected by an authenticated ADMIN.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to update the book with data violating a validation constraint.
scenarios.expected_result: The update is rejected with a validation error.

scenarios.precondition: An ADMIN selects a book with no active borrowings.
scenarios.expected_result: The book is removed from the catalog, deletion is logged, and confirmation is returned.

scenarios.precondition: An ADMIN selects a book with active borrowings.
scenarios.expected_result: Deletion is prevented because active borrowings exist.

scenarios.precondition: An authenticated MEMBER is within borrowing limits and the requested book is available.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Borrow the book using the default borrowing duration.
scenarios.expected_result: A borrowing record is created, book availability is updated, and a due date based on the default 30-day duration is provided.

scenarios.precondition: An authenticated MEMBER requests a book with no available copies.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to borrow the unavailable book.
scenarios.expected_result: The borrowing request is rejected with a constraint error.

scenarios.precondition: An authenticated MEMBER has reached the configured borrowing limit.
scenarios.expected_result: The borrowing request is rejected because the borrowing limit has been reached.

scenarios.precondition: An authenticated user has a valid borrowing record.
scenarios.expected_result: The borrowing status and book availability are updated, the return is logged, and confirmation is returned.

scenarios.precondition: The user is authenticated but the specified borrowing record is invalid.
scenarios.behavior_under_test: Attempt to return a book using the invalid borrowing record.
scenarios.expected_result: The return is rejected with an error.
